leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the map() method to transform arrays of data into JSX elements
Implement unique key props when rendering lists in React components
Construct dynamic list components that render variable amounts of data
Configure conditional rendering within mapped list items
Bind event handlers to individual items in rendered lists
Manipulate array data before rendering it as a list of components
Integrate nested object properties into list item displays
